name: parent_linked
description: Sent to a parent or carer who already has a login when another child is added to their parent portal.
subject: {pupil_first_name} added to your {school_name} parent portal
body: {pupil_name} has been added to your parent portal at {school_name}.
Sign in with your existing login ({username}) and choose {pupil_first_name} at the top of the portal.
If you weren't expecting this e-mail, please contact the school office.

placeholders.pupil_first_name: The pupil's preferred or first name
placeholders.pupil_name: The pupil's preferred first name and surname
